AND mvl.SERVER_IP = #{serverIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT ni.ID AS nodeId, ni.NODE_NAME AS nodeName, nmd.METRIC_NAME AS metricName, mvl.METRIC_VALUE AS metricValue, nmd.METRIC_UNIT AS metricUnit, nmd.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, mvl.SERVER_IP AS serverIp FROM T_MT_NODE_INFO ni LEFT JOIN T_MT_NODE_METRIC_DEF nmd ON ni.ID = nmd.NODE_ID LEFT JOIN T_MT_METRIC_VALUE_LATEST mvl ON nmd.ID = mvl.METRIC_ID AND mvl.NODE_ID = ni.ID
AND mvl.SERVER_IP = #{serverIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND mvl.SERVER_IP IS NULL
WHERE ni.ID = #{nodeId} ORDER BY nmd.SORT_ORDER

SELECT li.ID AS linkId, li.LINK_NAME AS linkName, sni.NODE_NAME AS sourceNodeName, tni.NODE_NAME AS targetNodeName, lmd.METRIC_NAME AS metricName, lvl.METRIC_VALUE AS metricValue, lmd.METRIC_UNIT AS metricUnit, lmd.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder FROM T_MT_LINK_INFO li LEFT JOIN T_MT_NODE_INFO sni ON li.SOURCE_NODE_ID = sni.ID LEFT JOIN T_MT_NODE_INFO tni ON li.TARGET_NODE_ID = tni.ID LEFT JOIN T_MT_LINK_METRIC_DEF lmd ON li.ID = lmd.LINK_ID LEFT JOIN T_MT_LINK_VALUE_LATEST lvl ON lmd.ID = lvl.METRIC_ID AND lvl.LINK_ID = li.ID ORDER BY li.LINK_NAME, lmd.SORT_ORDER

INSERT INTO T_MT_METRIC_VALUE_HISTORY (ID, COLLECT_ID, NODE_ID, METRIC_ID, SERVER_IP, METRIC_VALUE, SOURCE_TIME, CREATE_TIME)
SELECT SYS_GUID(), #{collectId}, #{item.nodeId}, #{item.metricId}, #{item.serverIp}, #{item.metricValue}, NVL(TO_DATE(#{item.sourceTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), SYSDATE), SYSDATE FROM DUAL

INSERT INTO T_MT_LINK_VALUE_HISTORY (ID, COLLECT_ID, LINK_ID, METRIC_ID, METRIC_VALUE, SOURCE_TIME, CREATE_TIME)
SELECT SYS_GUID(), #{collectId}, #{item.linkId}, #{item.metricId}, #{item.metricValue}, NVL(TO_DATE(#{item.sourceTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), SYSDATE), SYSDATE FROM DUAL

MERGE INTO T_MT_LINK_VALUE_LATEST t USING (
SELECT LINK_ID, METRIC_ID, METRIC_VALUE, SOURCE_TIME FROM ( SELECT q.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY LINK_ID, METRIC_ID ORDER BY SOURCE_TIME DESC) AS RN FROM (
SELECT #{item.linkId} AS LINK_ID, #{item.metricId} AS METRIC_ID, #{item.metricValue} AS METRIC_VALUE, NVL(TO_DATE(#{item.sourceTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), SYSDATE) AS SOURCE_TIME FROM DUAL
) q ) r WHERE r.RN = 1 ) s ON (t.LINK_ID = s.LINK_ID AND t.METRIC_ID = s.METRIC_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET COLLECT_ID = #{collectId}, METRIC_VALUE = s.METRIC_VALUE, SOURCE_TIME = s.SOURCE_TIME, CREATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID, COLLECT_ID, LINK_ID, METRIC_ID, METRIC_VALUE, SOURCE_TIME, CREATE_TIME) VALUES (SYS_GUID(), #{collectId}, s.LINK_ID, s.METRIC_ID, s.METRIC_VALUE, s.SOURCE_TIME, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT h.METRIC_VALUE AS metricValue, TO_CHAR(h.SOURCE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS sourceTime FROM T_MT_LINK_VALUE_HISTORY h JOIN T_MT_LINK_METRIC_DEF d ON h.METRIC_ID = d.ID WHERE h.LINK_ID = #{linkId} AND d.METRIC_NAME = #{metricName} AND h.SOURCE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND h.SOURCE_TIME <= TO_DATE(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY h.SOURCE_TIME ASC

SELECT d.METRIC_NAME AS metricName, h.METRIC_VALUE AS metricValue, TO_CHAR(h.SOURCE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS sourceTime FROM T_MT_LINK_VALUE_HISTORY h JOIN T_MT_LINK_METRIC_DEF d ON h.METRIC_ID = d.ID WHERE h.LINK_ID = #{linkId} AND h.SOURCE_TIME >= SYSDATE - #{hours} / 24 ORDER BY d.METRIC_NAME, h.SOURCE_TIME ASC
